message: The other night, we had a little power outage, and my kids thought it was the best thing since sliced bread. Suddenly, they were convinced we were on a camping trip right in our living room! I dug out our trusty flashlights and power banks, and we turned it into a fun evening of storytelling and snacking on whatever we could find in the fridge. It reminded me that a little preparedness can turn a blackout into a cozy family adventure. How do you keep the mood light during unexpected outages?
